core_categories: Medical Supplies; Health Equipment; Educational Resources; Sports Medicine Supplies; Special Education Supplies; School Safety Supplies
specialty_focus: School Health Corporation is a national, full-service distributor of medical supplies, health equipment, and educational resources for health professionals in educational settings from pre-school through college. It specializes in supplying school nurses, athletic trainers, and special education departments with health, safety, sports medicine, and special education products. The company does not specifically focus on wearable medical devices.
